definition: A severe, neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorder (also known as Batten disease) caused by mutations in CLN3, characterized by childhood-onset visual failure typically followed by progressive cognitive impairment, seizures, behavioral disturbances, motor deterioration, and premature death. In the context of CLN3-associated disease, it represents the severe syndromic neurodegenerative form that contrasts with nonsyndromic, retina-restricted conditions like retinitis pigmentosa.

source.title: Juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (Batten disease): current insights
source.quote: The present review is focused on juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (JNCL; Batten disease) due to a mutation in CLN3. Functional vision impairment occurring around 5-6 years of age is the first symptom in more than 80% of patients. Approximately 2 years later (though sometimes simultaneously), obvious signs of cognitive impairment appear.
